BackstoryDef.title: terratech scribling
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was selected to be a scribe of their people, and had to start [PAWN_possessive] training early. With this came a high status, but also high expectations.

BackstoryDef.title: terratech cropling
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] began [PAWN_possessive] life as most other terratech children do; learning a bit of every role before their role was chosen for them. [PAWN_pronoun] would work massive fields one day, then assist someone else amongst the tribe the next.\n\nThis life was boring and monotonous, but [PAWN_nameDef] become familiar with skills that would benefit any role they took in the future.

BackstoryDef.title: terratech surrogate
BackstoryDef.description: Once the child of another faction, [PAWN_nameDef] was adopted - or perhaps kidnapped - by the tribe when [PAWN_pronoun] was still a baby. Terratech culture dictates that the best fighters and operatives be of outside bloodlines, and for better of worse, [PAWN_nameDef] ended up being one of those chosen children.
